## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design resource isolation and practical configuration with systemd and cgroups in a multi-tenant environment, focusing on I/O pressure rather than CPU/memory alone.

## Key Concepts
- cgroup v2 io.max throttling
- systemd slices and per-service isolation
- per-device I/O limits and hierarchy
- reproducible load testing with fio and iostat

## Code Example
```javascript
# Example: set per-device I/O throttling for tenant-a.slice (pseudo)
sudo mkdir -p /sys/fs/cgroup/tenant-a.slice
echo "8:0 rbps=50M wbps=50M" | sudo tee /sys/fs/cgroup/tenant-a.slice/io.max
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you adapt if the workload alternates between read-heavy and write-heavy?
- What are potential pitfalls with block layer throttling and caches?

CG="/sys/fs/cgroup"
for t in tenantA tenantB; do

  # I/O weight bias for per-tenant I/O

done

```bash
/var/log/myapp.log {
  rotate 5
  weekly
  missingok
  notifempty
  postrotate

  endscript
}
```
